raw_text: China Builds New Bridge at Contested Pangong Lake Border Area. Commercial satellite imagery analyzed by The War Zone reveals that China's People's Liberation Army has constructed what appears to be a new permanent bridge near the Finger 8 area of Pangong Tso lake in eastern Ladakh. The bridge, approximately 400 meters long, connects the north and south banks of a narrow section of the lake that falls within Chinese-claimed territory. The construction appears to have been completed in early January 2024 based on comparison with older imagery. This bridge would allow the PLA to rapidly move armored vehicles and heavy equipment between positions on either side of the lake without the lengthy road detour currently required. Indian defense officials have not yet commented on the development.
